Name: The Hedgewitchs Almanac
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[left][center][size=6][color=#ff5fa2][b]⚠ WORK IN PROGRESS ⚠[/b][/color][/size]
[size=5][b]This mod is still a WIP and WILL BE UPDATED 1x A MONTH![/b][/size]
New herbs, recipes, familiars and magical objects arrive every month. Endorse and track the mod so you never miss one.[/center]

[center][size=6][b]🌿 The Hedgewitch's Almanac ✨[/b][/size]
[i]Herbalism, witchcraft and cozy magic for Stardew Valley[/i][/center]

Bring more witchcraft, herbalism and cozy magic to the Valley! Grow and forage herbs, brew remedies, bake bread in a hearthstone oven, hang a seasonal wreath on your door, collect brooms and travel with a familiar at your side. Everything is discoverable at your own pace, and the in-game Almanac explains it all. 🧙‍♀️🌸🧹🐸
[/left]
[left][size=5][b]📋 Requirements[/b][/size]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (required)[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] (required)[/*]
[*][b]Parchment[/b] (required, shows the Almanac guidebook)[/*]
[*]The [b]Hedgewitch's Broom[/b] companion is [b]included in the same download[/b]. No separate download needed.[/*]
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], but SVE is not required.

[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and Parchment.[/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. It contains two folders: [b]TheHedgewitchsAlmanac[/b] and [b]HedgewitchsBroom[/b].[/*]
[*]Updating? Delete both old folders first and replace them with both new ones. Back up your saves.[/*]
[*]New saves get a welcome letter on Spring 1 with the Almanac, Field Journal and a broom. Existing saves get a one-time catch-up letter. Pierre sells all three.

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]🌱 Herbs, crops and foraging[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Grow Moonmint, Sunpetal, Witchroot, Comfrey, Yarrow, Hearthsage, Moonbell, Mossheart and more. Seeds at Pierre's.[/*]
[*]Forage seasonal herbs around the Valley, with rare finds tied to weather and location.[/*]
[*]Three winter herbs: Rimeleaf, Yulewort and the rare Frostember.[/*]
[*]Seasonal flowers (Starbell, Foxglow, Duskrose), teas with custom buffs, and a decorative Wildflower Vase.[/*]
[*]Herbalism progression that rewards gathering, harvesting and brewing.

[size=4][b]🧹 Three brooms[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Frogbloom Broom[/b] (250g): [color=#ff9ecf]REMADE[/color] with a fresh frog-and-blossoms design.[/*]
[*][b]Lantern Broom[/b] (400g): about 50% faster, smooth, with a swaying lantern.[/*]
[*][b]Stardust Comet Broom[/b] (600g): [color=#ff9ecf]NEW[/color] star-tipped, comet bristles, swaying herb bundle. The fastest.[/*]
[*]Three upgrades (Waxed Handle Wrap, Gleaming Lantern Wick, Stardust Bristle Binding) make them faster still.[/*]
[*]Fully animated ridden sprites in all four directions.

[size=4][b]🪄 Enchanted Broom Stand[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Hang up to four brooms, including brooms from other mods. They float, bob, sparkle and glow after dark. Pierre, 600g.

[size=4][b]🐸 Four familiars[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Marshlight the Frog[/b]: wear it as a hat accessory.[/*]
[*][b]Moonquill the Raven[/b] and [b]Hushwing the Ghost Owl[/b]: fly after you and perch on your shoulder.[/*]
[*][b]Sootpaw the Black Cat[/b] and [b]Mossback the Toad[/b]: [color=#ff9ecf]NEW[/color] walk and hop behind you.[/*]
[*]Each has its own bond, memories, Field Journal scrapbook page and close-bond perk. One follows at a time.

[size=4][b]🫖 Brewing, cooking and baking[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Apothecary Brewing Station[/b]: remedies, elixirs, teas and cozy foods.[/*]
[*][b]Witch's Cauldron[/b]: herbs plus the day's tarot card decide the potion. Five potions, or a Murky Brew if the cards are unkind.[/*]
[*][b]Hearthstone Oven[/b]: five breads (Hearthsage Loaf, Sunpetal Sweet Roll, Witchroot Rye, Moonbell Bun, Yule Wreath Bread), each with its own buff.[/*]
[*]Winter recipes: Frostward Draught, Yule Cordial, Rimeleaf Winter Tea, Yulewort Spice Cake, Frostember Jam Tart.

[size=4][b]🌙 Moon Jar and Moon Water[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Fill the Moon Jar with a watering can, the wand's [b]Moonwell Charm[/b] spell, or let it [b]collect rain[/b] on rainy mornings when left outdoors.[/*]
[*]Get Moon Water, or Full Moon Water on the 14th and 28th. Use them to brew Moonlit Tea and Silverdew Elixir.

[size=4][b]🔮 Divination and magic[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Crystal Ball[/b]: check the weather, summon rain or pass a few hours.[/*]
[*][b]Valley Tarot[/b]: draw a card a day for helpful or challenging buffs. Fortune cards can change Pierre's prices.[/*]
[*][b]Fortune Table[/b]: read for a villagers in town once a day.[/*]
[*][b]Moon Altar[/b]: make a nightly offering for a day-long blessing.[/*]
[*][b]Dewdrop Wand[/b]: four spells (Droplets of Dew, Gentle Downpour, Fill the Bowl, Moonwell Charm).

[size=4][b]🚪 Witch-Bell Wreath[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Hang it on your farmhouse door. It changes with the seasons automatically, chimes as you pass and sways in the rain.[/*]
[*]A [i]config.json[/i] lets you nudge its position or turn the chime off.

[size=4][b]📖 Almanac and Field Journal[/b][/size][/*]
[*]An illustrated guidebook with pages for every herb, tool and familiar.[/*]
[*]A Field Journal that tracks herb locations, recipes, flowers, Herbalism and every familiar's scrapbook.

[size=4][b]❄ Optional Yule Party[/b][/size][/*]
[*]The winter 25 festival can appear as the Yule Party. Toggle it in the Content Patcher config.

[size=5][b]📝 Notes[/b][/size][/*]
[*]Text drawn by the Broom companion (Field Journal, menus, tarot readings) is English-only for now.[/*]
[*]Compatibility with other food, texture or content mods is not guaranteed.[/*]
[*]Found a bug? Please post it with your SMAPI log (smapi.io/log). Thank you!

[center][size=5][b]🌟 Still growing: new content every month! 🌟[/b][/size][/center]


[/*]
[/left]
